windows_candidate.input: Windows UI Automation and an owned WM_CLOSE message

live_provider.scope: Two app-server sessions in Linux using the candidate managed agent assembly and a native 0.0.326 shared owner.

development_failures: The initial owned-window prototype cancelled its parent close. Native closing stayed false in the diagnostic reproduction. The final implementation uses tabs in the creator with explicit retirement.
The first tabbed test mistook a PowerShell probe label for the tab name. UI Automation showed the correct tab. The corrected harness passed against the same binaries.
limitations: The Windows UI run used a deterministic app-server peer. The live provider trial ran separately on Linux.
Users enter review tasks. Automatic delegation, editable worker drafts, multi-provider specialists and persisted specialist sessions are outside this checkpoint.
reproduction: Publish the Windows desktop with scripts/build_desktop.py and the AgentRpc fixture for win-x64.
Run tests/creator_workspace.ps1 with -Editor, -Output and -CodexReviews pointing to the published fixture.
